safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold lists penicillin allergy; Generated only documents denial of food/pet allergies and does not mention penicillin.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting a penicillin allergy can lead to inadvertent prescribing/administration of penicillin-class antibiotics in the future, which could trigger an allergic reaction including anaphylaxis. Allergy documentation errors are high-risk because they directly affect medication safety.
